title: Iruvarin Ulagam Ondre
desc: A man and a woman, who are born on the same day, fall in love with each other. However, due to unfortunate circumstances, they keep getting separated.

title: Poda Podi
desc: Arjun and Nisha happily marry as they are madly in love with each other. However, trouble brews in their lives when they realize that they have to make a lot of sacrifices to make their marriage work.

title: Oh Mana Penne
desc: Shruthi and Karthik launch a food truck, but fate has unexpected plans for them.

title: Thambi
desc: Parvathy hesitates to welcome her brother Saravanan back after 15 years. However, she unravels a well-orchestrated conspiracy, realizing not everything is as it seems.

title: Pa.Pandi
desc: Pandi, a retired stuntman, has an argument and leaves home to find his long-lost love, Poothendral. They meet and Poothendral invites him home for lunch where he is reunited with his son and grandson.

title: Good Luck Sakhi
desc: Plagued by misfortune, a young woman overcomes tragedy, trains as a sharpshooter, and competes at the national level.

title: Naalavathu Singam
desc: A corrupt IPS officer joins GK, a local politician, in his immoral activities. When GK's brother kills the officer's best friend, he decides to take revenge against GK.

title: Nani'S Gang Leader
desc: Five women enlist a crime novelist named Pencil to help them seek revenge for the deaths of their loved ones in a robbery.

title: Mudinja Vazhu
desc: A reality show participant investigates a haunted bungalow where his brother died, as part of a TV channel's spooky reality show.

title: Poi Solla Porom
desc: After purchasing a plot for his dream home, a man faces its usurpation by goons. Initially indifferent, his son eventually decides to retaliate against the goons.

title: Nedunchalai
desc: Murugan, plays a cat and mouse game with Insp. Masani after stealing from trucks.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoomi is all set to get married but her life changes when Vishal and his cousin rape her. She and her father set out to punish the perpetrators.

title: Ponmagal Vandhal
desc: A courageous lawyer defends a woman labelled a serial killer, uncovering a web of child abuse and corruption in her pursuit of justice.

title: Jeeva
desc: Jeeva, who has a natural talent in cricket, dreams of playing for the Indian cricket team. However, his love life and politics in the sports governing body become obstacles to his ambition.

title: Pailwaan
desc: Krishna, an orphan raised by gym owner Sarkar, overcomes adversity to become a wrestler. However, conflict arises with his mentor when he falls in love.

title: Ghajinikanth
desc: Rajinikanth, who has temporary memory loss, often embarrasses his parents and peers. He faces a challenge when he falls in love with Vandhana and seeks the acceptance of her parents.

title: Theal
desc: While orphaned Durai feels content with his life and earns by mercilessly torturing the poor, he experiences an epiphany when a middle-aged woman enters his life claiming to be his mother.

title: Sreemannarayana
desc: Journalist Sriman exposes a corrupt minister, while his activist father raises funds for farmers. After his father's death and the disappearance of the money, Sriman finds himself a prime suspect.

title: Mayaanadhi
desc: Maathen, a gang member, accidentally kills a police officer and plans to meet his beloved Aparna before leaving, escalating the suspense surrounding his life.

title: Naan Aanaiyittal
desc: Sundaram, a millionaire's son, is abducted by robbers. Years later, he learns the truth about his birth, leading to a series of events uncovering his past.
